workspaces_description: Lists, registers and relinks the workspaces JGates knows.
workspaces_unknown_action_fix: Use: jgates workspaces list [--json], add <path> or relink <oldId> --cwd <new path>
workspaces_relink_missing_id: Give the id of the old workspace.
workspaces_relink_not_found_fix: See the ids with: jgates workspaces list
workspaces_relink_same: The new path is the same workspace: {id}
workspaces_relink_cycle: The history of {id} already descends from the new workspace.
workspaces_relink_cycle_fix: Relink in the other direction or choose another path.
